en: Colorized historical postcard showing a ceremonial military parade on a city street. Soldiers line both sides of the road while a mounted escort accompanies a central figure on horseback, likely a king, moving through the crowd. Civilians with umbrellas watch from the sides. The background features early 20th‑century multi‑story buildings. A caption panel at the bottom is printed in Greek and French, and a modern website watermark appears on the right.
